Commentary.Commentary: The hosts wouldn't be very happy with their efforts but a disciplined bowling performance can make this match interesting. Can Eoin Morgan and co clinch the series or will the Calypso boys level it? Join us in a bit for the chase....

Coming to the hosts, it was the pair of Jason Mohammed and Jonathan Carter - along with a sedate innings from Kraigg Brathwaite at the top - that performed again in this do-or-die match for the Windies. Mohammed slammed his second consecutive fifty while Carter scored 39 at the strike rate of 108.33.

England have done extremely well to bundle West Indies out for 225. The pitch was slow and two paced, and the visitors put together a brilliant collective bowling performance to take full advantage of the deck. Except Chris Woakes, all the other bowlers managed to take a wicket. However, he kept things tight as he was the most economical bowler for the tourists. The fast bowlers did notably well extracting good bounce and making the opposition uncomfortable on regular occasions.

OUT! That is a bull's eye from Buttler! No wonder he is smiling. What an aim! Landed outside off, Bishoo looks to run it down to third man but gets it off the bottom half of the bat. The ball goes towards short third man and the batsmen go for the single. But Jos Buttler is quicker, gets to the ball, turns and has a shy at the striker's end. He has one stump to aim at and he hits. Terrific. Gabriel is nowhere in the frame. WEST INDIES BOWLED OUT FOR 225!

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SHANNON GABRIEL is the last man in.
OUT! BOWLED! Length ball just outside off, coming in, Nurse looks to go big over the top but misses. The ball hits the middle stump. Not quite what the doctor ordered for the Windies.

One from long on and one from mid-wicket. Jason Roy steadies himself under it, takes the catch but then realizes that he is near the ropes. He throws the ball to Sam Billings, steps out and then comes back in to join the celebrations. It is referred upstairs and sure enough, Roy is fine.

WIDE. A short ball down the leg side, Brathwaite misses out on the pull.
Oops.... a length ball outside off, Nurse looks to defend but misses. The ball goes past the outside edge but does not carry to Jos Buttler. He fumbles and the batsmen take a bye.
WIDE. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.

FOUR! Superbly down. Too straight from Plunkett, around off on a length, Brathwaite just helps it past short fine leg and gets a boundary! Moves to 22 from 20 balls. Change in the field. Short fine leg drops back.
Full and outside off, placed behind point for a couple.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes back on.

Short and outside off, Brathwaite looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge which flies past short third man. Moeen Ali looks to slide near the boundary but some of the grass comes off the surface and he slips. Manages to stop the ball but is in pain. Three runs taken. He looks okay now.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Full and outside off, CB looks to play the slog sweep but misses.
Very full outside off, Carlos looks to drive but gets a bottom edge.
FOUR! FETCH THAT! Full and outside off, Brathwaite blasts it past the bowler down the ground for a boundary! 200 COMES UP FOR WEST INDIES!
ASHLEY NURSE walks in at number 9, replacing Holder.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Rashid gets his first. Floated outside off, Holder looks to go over the top but gets a top edge. The ball has gone nowhere and for a moment, it seems it will fall safe. Rashid initially goes to his left, circles under the ball, but then realizes that the ball is to his right. Calls for he catch, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a steepler. Very, very good catch.

TOP EDGE, SAFE! A short ball around off, Carlos looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes off his helmet too, lobs towards square leg, Woakes runs after it but cannot get there. The bats,em do not run. Lazy.

A length ball around middle, Holder looks to work it through the leg side but gets it on the body. The batsmen go for the quick single and Woakes hares after it. Seems like Brathwaite would be gone as Woakes flicks the ball at the striker's end but hits Brathwaite in the process. No signal from the umpire for a leg bye, so must have been an inside edge.

Similar ball, a touch fuller, driven straight to cover. Just 4 from the over.
Very full outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Full on middle and off, now Jason goes for the slog but mistimes it through mid-wicket. Just a single.
Tossed up outside off, Holder looks to play the reverse sweep but the ball goes off his gloves and lobs towards short third man. Does not carry.
Floated outside off, Brathwaite reaches out and whips it towards long on for a run.

Outside off, a play and a miss.
Works it down the leg side for a couple.

Full and outside off, Brathwaite pushes hard and the ball goes off the outside edge through the vacant slip cordon past short third man. Two runs taken.
One more wrong 'un, Carlos lunges to defend, does not pick the googly again and is hit on the pads. The appeal is turned down once more.
A googly, around off, Brathwaite looks to defend but the ball spins in and hits the pads. Another LBW appeal ensues, maybe going down leg.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call! So, so unlucky for Rashid. It was a lovely delivery, tossed up around middle and leg. Holder got down and attempted a paddle but missed. Was hit on the pads and Rashid appealed, literally going near the umpire, ala Muralidaran. But the umpire moved away. Rashid immediately asked Morgan to go for the review and replays were inconclusive whether there was glove or not. However, Hawk Eye indicated the ball to be clipping the top of the off stump, so the umpire's call stays. A leg bye taken in the meanwhile.
Howzzat? Rashid feels Holder is gone. The umpire doesn't agree. Rashid is almost near the umpire, pleading. Morgan goes for the review.
Outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Full and around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
ADIL RASHID is back on. A slip is in place as well. Rashid is pretty effective against lower order batsmen.
POWERPLAY 3 time. Can the Windies demonstrate some power? 250 looks to be a good total on this track. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Outside off, played straight to short third man.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

CHRIS WOAKES comes back on to bowl.
Outside off, pushed towards mid on.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE walks in at number 8, replacing Carter.

OUT! Another set batsman falls. Carter was looking to accelerate but has been consumed by the temptation. Many times, a batsman is unable to get a balance between caution and aggression. Just 2 runs had come in this over before this ball. And Carter wanted to multiply those. Got a length ball, Carter went for the heave-ho but only miscued it high in the air. Adil Rashid at mid off completed the formalities. Another fine innings from Carter. He is slowly but surely becoming a dependable player for the Windies.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.

On middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED? Too harsh maybe. Technically, yes. Landed outside off, comes in with the angle, Carter looks to punch it through the off side but the bat hits his pad and the ball goes off the outside edge onto Buttler's pads who is unable to get up in time.
SIX! That is a big hit! Flighted around off, Carter comes down the track and sends this sailing over long on!
On middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.

Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Similar ball, eased through the covers for a single to get off the mark.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Did the ball hold off the pitch? Maybe, not sure. A length ball around off, Mohammed looks to perhaps hit it over mid on but it turns out to be half-hearted. He ends up checking his shot and it is a soft chip, which is calmly taken by Adil Rashid at mid on, moving to his right. The quickfire 41-run stand is broken.
On a good length around leg stump, tucked through square leg for a single. Carter wants the second but is sent back.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes on to bowl now.
DRINKS BREAK.
Similar line and length, this is swept straight to Billings at deep square leg, so it is just a single.

FOUR! FEROCIOUS! That is a long hop, outside off, Carter goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, pushed towards point.

On a length outside off, Mohammed pushes it towards cover and sets off. But then he sees Eoin Morgan get to the ball and stops. Carter is halfway down the track and there is a chance of a run out but Morgan does not collect the ball cleanly. Carter gives Mohammed a piece of his mind.
WIDE. A short ball down the leg side, Mohammed misses his tuck.

Excellent piece of fielding. Short and outside off, Carter slaps it through the covers. Sam Billings gives it a good chase from the deep to his left, dives and then pulls it back in just inside the ropes. The batsmen run three this time!

Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.

England appeal for a LBW. Ali pitches this on  off side which spins back in and Brathwaite gets struck on his back pad. They go up but the umpire is unmoved. Could've reviewed it but decide against it!

Landed outside off, defended back from the crease.

Shortish delivery, JM punches it back to the bowler.
Lower full toss, Brathwaite sweeps it with the inner part of the bat through the leg side for a single.

On a length outside off, Mohammed guides it towards third man. One run added to the total!

The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Bowls a length ball outside off, JM cuts it straight to the point fielder.

The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Leg bye! Back of a length delivery, around leg, Mohammed looks to tuck it away but it hits his pads and goes towards short fine leg. They run a leg bye.
Full delivery around off, Mohammed drives it towards covers.
Length ball outside off, JM pushes it towards covers.
Jason Mohammed comes out to replace Shai Hope!

OUT! Stokes strikes in his second over. Short of a length ball outside off, Hope looks to cut it away but it takes the edge and Buttler gathers an easy catch. West Indies lose their third wicket. The umpire go upstairs to check the no ball but Stokes' landing is fine!
Bowls an off cuter, Brathwaite opens the face of the bat and plays it towards third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, Brathwaite pats it towards point.
Marginally ahead of length, around middle, Hope is solid in defense.
Good length delivery, on middle and leg, Hope drives it towards mid on.

Length ball outside off, Hope goes back and punches it towards point.
Back of a length delivery which nips back in, Brathwaite nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Bowls a well directed shortish delivery, Hope tucks it away with soft hands for a single.
Length ball, which nips back in, Hope punches it towards mid on.
Angles in a length ball, which stays low, Hope does well to keep it out.
Length ball outside off, Hope gets on his toes and drives it beautifully through covers for a couple.
Starts with a slower delivery outside off, Hope fails to put bat to ball.
Double bowling change! Ben Stokes comes into the attack.
Length ball around middle, Brathwaite blocks it on the back foot.
Back of a length delivery, Hope punches it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total!
Full ball outside off, Brathwaite opens the face of the bat and intentionally edges it towards third man for a single.
Angles in a length ball, on middle, Hope drives it to wide of mid on. They run a single.
Length ball, around middle and leg, Hope goes forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full ball outside off, Hope leans forward and defends it towards covers.

Powerplay 2 has been signalled!
Bowls the slower one outside off, Brathwaite pats it towards backward point.
Length ball on middle, KB drives it towards mid on.

FOUR! Bangs this short, KB waits for it and pulls it through mid-wicket. Three fielders - square leg, mid-wicket run behind it and deep square leg hares across to stop it. But the ball beats them all to race away to the boundary.
Angles in a length ball which comes back in, Brathwaite drives it with an angled bat towards mid on.
Length ball on the sticks, KB goes back and defends it towards the off side.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Brathwaite goes back to defend it.
Short of a length delivery, Hope tucks it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Short and wide, Hope gets over the ball and slaps it on the back foot between point and covers for a boundary. A beautiful stroke and gets the expected result!

Length ball around middle and leg, Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket. The fielder chases it but fails to stop it after sliding. West Indies take advantage of that and steal an extra run. Two runs added to the total!

Length ball outside off, Hope looks to defend but the ball whizzes past his willow.
Short and wide, Hope cuts it straight towards covers.

DROPPED! On a length outside off, looks to cut but it takes the edge and goes towards Root at gully. He dives to his right but the ball is too fast and puts it down. He parries the ball towards third man and they run a single.
Length ball angling away, Brathwaite gets on the ball and pushes it towards covers.
Back of a length delivery, chest height, Hope gets on his toes and defends it with soft hands onto the ground.
Lands this on a length which nips back in, Hope nudges it towards square leg.

Length ball outside off, Brathwaite steers it down to third man for a single.

Good length delivery on middle, Brathwaite pushes it towards the leg side.
Length ball outside off, Brathwaite cuts it unconvincingly and the ball just ahead of him.

FOUR! And another. Some intent from the southpaw here. Length ball outside off, Lewis waits for and drives it on the up towards covers for a boundary. Back-to-back boundaries for him.
FOUR! A Chris Gayle-esque shot. On a length outside off, Lewis gets across and whacks it through cover for a boundary. What a boundary to start proceedings!
Starts his spell with a length ball around middle and leg, Kraigg flicks it towards mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
The players are out in the middle. English fielders are taking their positions. Kraigg Brathwaite and Evin Lewis too have arrived at the crease. Eoin Morgan tosses the first new ball to Steven Finn.

England captain, Eoin Morgan says they are fielding the same side. Informs that Alex Hales is not fit which will give Sam Billings one more chance. Admits that he wanted to bowl first, informs that the performance in the first match was complete.

West Indies captain, Jason Holder says that it looks like a dry pitch and they will bat first. Informs that he will play the same XI. Mentions that there a couple of areas that they need to improve. Reckons that Shannon Gabriel was brilliant last game and hopes that he repeats the same today.

Pitch report - Jeffrey Dujon says that the first ODI deck is only going to be used but mentions that it isn't that tacky as it was in the last match. Says that there is a little bit sheen now which suggests that the pitch is a little bit drier. Talks about a spot from the Andy Roberts end which is a little dark, expects that it will bounce and swing more from that area. He informs that bowling first is a good option.
TOSS - West Indies win the toss and elect to bat first. Both sides are unchanged.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the 2nd ODI between West Indies and England. A chance for the visitors to clinch the series so that they would be able to try out more combinations in the third match. The pitch is going to be more on the drier side and batsmen would have to grind out in the middle to score their runs. This West Indies side is very young and it will be interesting to see if they learn from their mistakes in the previous match. Given that both the teams are going to play at the same ground, any changes in the playing XI are not expected. We will find out more at the toss...
